question: In which types of fire rites does omission create a ritual fault requiring remedy?
premises: Fire rites may be daily, occasional, or desire-driven.
Any of these rites may be left undone.
Omission in such rites requires corrective action.
inference: Therefore omission in daily, occasional, or desire-driven fire rites constitutes a fault requiring remedy.
plain_english: This applies when a fire rite, whether daily, occasional, or desire-driven, has not been performed.
